normalizationRules: All records remain PROPOSED and non-governing.
Source self-labels cannot promote records to CURRENT or FINAL.
Commercial values require independent authority, effective dating, and owner approval.
The governing production-isolation baseline applies to every production customer.

records.title: Batch 1 source corpus registration
records.assertion: Register the seven files at the independently reviewed head as SOURCE_MATERIAL_ONLY with no automatic promotion.
promotionDependencies: Acquire and archive originals and hashes.

records.title: Master prompt modular composition model
records.assertion: Adopt atomic, versioned prompt components and composition manifests pinned to immutable component versions.
promotionDependencies: Incorporate the additional authoritative corpus.
Complete owner and Project Knowledge review.

records.title: Prompt rule precedence model
records.assertion: Use explicit precedence and rule-level supersession. A source file's self-label has no promotion authority.
promotionDependencies: Validate against authoritative FINAL/CURRENT Project Knowledge.

records.title: Customer-facing identity and mode separation
records.assertion: Resolve customer-selected identity, suppress internal labels, and make demo, installed, roleplay, and debrief modes explicit.
promotionDependencies: Define agent-instance configuration and the mode/state schema.

records.title: Context read-first and live correction policy
records.assertion: Hydrate authoritative context before asking, reuse populated values, and handle live corrections with provenance and controlled persistence.
promotionDependencies: Approve authority, freshness, null, and mirror contracts.

records.title: Layered discovery and trial-close method
records.assertion: Use multi-item layered discovery and an open, benefit-forward close; higher-priority states stop unnecessary probing.
promotionDependencies: Verify against authoritative Project Knowledge.
Approve acceptance fixtures.

records.title: Database reactivation flow profiles
records.assertion: Model optional transfer, assumed transfer, no-AI transfer, and downstream closer as distinct profiles.
promotionDependencies: Define a deterministic profile selector and fallback configuration.

records.title: Sarah-to-James phone demo continuity
records.assertion: James resumes Sarah context without restarting and owns the final summary.
promotionDependencies: Approve a typed handoff schema and current platform mapping.

records.title: Kelly-to-Matt SmartSite flow
records.assertion: Kelly engages the website visitor first; Matt performs deeper roleplay and closing; Kelly closes when no transfer occurs.
promotionDependencies: Verify authoritative prompts and runtime behavior.

records.title: Two-tier SmartSite discovery isolation
records.assertion: Store simulated visitor insights and actual owner or prospect insights as separate, related subject sets with explicit provenance.
promotionDependencies: Define canonical subject, session, and synthetic-data types.

records.title: Conversation handoff scope
records.assertion: Keep handoffs and summaries canonical in D1 conversation records with governed optional GHL mirrors, not account Custom Values.
promotionDependencies: Approve final schema, mappings, and migration plan.

records.title: Canonical data ownership pattern
records.assertion: D1 owns normalized intelligence, configuration, and mappings; AutoCalls receives role variables; GHL contains only selected mirrors.
promotionDependencies: Compare against the existing schema and current runtime configurations.

records.title: Production customer isolation correction
records.assertion: Preserve the workbook's shared-D1 assumption only as history. The governing platform baseline requires a separate Worker and D1 for every production customer.
promotionDependencies: Write the approved conflict and supersession record to Project Knowledge.
Do not reintroduce a paying-customer qualifier.

records.title: SmartSite commercial terms candidate
records.assertion: Treat $197 Base and $297 Pro, the prohibition on unlimited or included claims, and reactive approximate usage framing only as an unverified commercial candidate.
promotionDependencies: Obtain commercial-owner approval.
Define market, currency, tax, eligibility, and effective dates.

records.title: Post-demo disposition vocabulary candidate
records.assertion: Treat the five exact lowercase disposition tags in the source as an unverified candidate vocabulary.
promotionDependencies: Resolve CRM identifiers, destination and workflow semantics, and owner approval.

records.title: Handoff payload contract candidate
records.assertion: Define a typed payload containing source session, agent, channel, entity, context, insight items, objections, urgency, desired outcome, transfer reason, and ownership.
promotionDependencies: Approve required and optional fields, privacy, retention, freshness, and acknowledgement rules.

records.title: State-priority and stop-condition policy
records.assertion: Opt-out, human or support requests, frustration or refusal, high intent, and direct action override normal probing and action cadence.
promotionDependencies: Validate compliance and action mappings.

records.title: Entity-specific sales knowledge normalization
records.assertion: Store insight items separately and relate them to products, services, AI employees, offers, demos, plans, promotions, and niches.
promotionDependencies: Approve the final entity schema and controlled vocabulary.

records.title: Batch 1 unresolved-material gate
records.assertion: Do not finalize the master prompt architecture until authoritative Project Knowledge and the additional master-prompt corpus are incorporated.
promotionDependencies: Attach or otherwise provide authoritative Project Knowledge.
Ingest and reconcile the remaining corpus.

nonBatch1RuntimeConstraints.requirement: Cloudflare runtime integrations use machine-to-machine service authentication through managed secrets and bindings; interactive OAuth is not a runtime dependency.
